annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2020/746 of 4 June 2020 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 as regards postponing dates of application of certain measures in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2020/746 of 4 June 2020 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 as regards postponing dates of application of certain measures in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 176/13
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation postponing application dates of the EU drone (UAS) operation rules in Implementing Regulation 2019/947 by about six months because of COVID-19 disruption to registration systems, standardisation and testing, allowing non-compliant UAS to keep operating under existing conditions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Postpones Article 20 and 21 application dates of Regulation 2019/947 by six months (to 1 Jan 2022/2023).
Extends the transitional period in Article 22 from two years to 30 months.
Allows UAS not complying with Delegated Regulation 2019/945 to operate for six more months.
Cites delays in digital registration systems and remote identification testing.
Enters into force the day after publication; binding and directly applicable.
